nodes.label: Position the vehicle toward the side of the lane corresponding to the turn and look as far along the intended path as possible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Complete a turn with smooth acceleration, cancel the signal and check traffic behind.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A right turn starts from the far-right part of the lane; do not swing left before making it.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A left turn starts from the far-left part of the lane and requires yielding to approaching opposing traffic.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Where multiple lanes turn together, choose the correct lane in advance and remain within it through the turn.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After missing an exit on a divided highway, continue to the next exit rather than stopping, backing or attempting a turnabout.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Before considering a U-turn, check whether a sign prohibits it because the maneuver is not legal in every location.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The described U-turn procedure begins by signaling and pulling to the right shoulder, waiting for clear traffic and signaling before turning into the nearest opposing-direction lane.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A two-point turn uses a side street, alley or driveway to reverse direction when driving around the block is impractical or impossible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: For the reverse two-point turn, signal right, stop and check side and rear traffic before slowly backing into the driveway and straightening the wheels.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After backing into the driveway, stop, select forward drive and check both directions before signaling a left turn into the proper lane.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: For the forward two-point turn, check mirrors, signal left and enter the driveway near its right side, stopping after the rear clears the road edge.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Before reversing out of the driveway, check every direction, signal right and back slowly only when the path is clear; straighten and stop in the nearest lane before moving forward.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Use a three-point turn only on a two-lane road that is too narrow for a U-turn.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A three-point turn begins with mirror checks and a right signal to pull aside, followed by a left signal and traffic and blind-spot checks before crossing toward the opposite side.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After the first movement of a three-point turn, select reverse, check both sides and traffic, and reverse with right steering only when clear.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Finish a three-point turn by selecting forward drive, signaling left and rechecking traffic and blind spots before entering the right-hand lane in the new direction.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Expect that another road user might disobey a control and remain ready to avoid a collision.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Before entering from a stop, check left, right and left again for crossing traffic and bicycles.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A new green signal does not justify immediate entry; first ensure the path is clear and there is enough room and time for the intended movement.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Do not enter in front of an approaching vehicle solely because its turn signal is operating; the signal could refer to a later turn or have been left on accidentally.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Before entering a multilane roundabout, use the exit signs, lane-use signs and pavement markings to choose the appropriate lane.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Yield to vehicles in both roundabout lanes and enter only when a suitable opening appears.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Keep your chosen roundabout lane until exiting and avoid changing lanes inside the circle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Do not pass, overtake or travel beside another vehicle in the roundabout; a large vehicle may need space in both lanes.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: If an emergency vehicle approaches before you enter a roundabout, stay out and pull right while allowing traffic to clear its path.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: If already inside a roundabout when an emergency vehicle approaches, continue through and exit before pulling right; never stop within the circle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The school-bus rule specifies stopping at least twenty-five feet away in any direction when its red warning lights flash or its stop arm is extended, subject to the stated physically divided-road exception.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Remain stopped for the school bus until it moves again or its flashing red lights cease, then proceed slowly while watching for children.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Parked vehicles must not create a road hazard, and a vehicle beside a rural highway should be removed from its paved or main traveled portion.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: If completely leaving the road is impossible, pull off as far as possible while preserving a clear two hundred-foot view each way and enough space for vehicles to pass.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Police may tow an abandoned roadside vehicle even when it is well outside the traveled lane.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: If a disabled vehicle must remain for several hours, leave a windshield note describing the problem, expected removal time and a way to contact the owner or driver.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: When parking beside a road, maximize separation from moving traffic and keep close to a curb where one is present.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An unattended vehicle must have its engine switched off and key removed; the manual also advises locking it.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Use park for an automatic vehicle or leave a manual vehicle in gear, and apply the parking brake to prevent movement.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Do not open a parked vehicle's door into passing traffic.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Check signs and curb markings for restrictions before choosing a parking location.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Reserved accessible spaces and their adjacent striped access aisles are protected by parking law, with fines for violations.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An access aisle supplies room for a door, wheelchair, lift or ramp and may require its entire marked width for safe entry or exit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A person unable to enter or leave safely because a vehicle blocks an access aisle should immediately contact local police.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: People with walking disabilities or their drivers may report an illegally parked vehicle using a photograph and sworn statement submitted to local police.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Parking is prohibited beside another parked vehicle, on a sidewalk or crosswalk, inside an intersection, on a bridge or in a highway tunnel.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Do not park in front of a driveway, in a hazardous position, or where traffic lacks sufficient room to pass.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Keep parked vehicles at least fifteen feet from a fire hydrant and at least twenty feet from an intersection crosswalk.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Do not park within thirty feet of a stop sign, yield sign or traffic signal.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The prohibited fire-station approach covers twenty feet from its driveway entrance and seventy-five feet on the opposite side of the street.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Do not park within fifty feet of a railroad crossing's nearest rail.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: For perpendicular or angled parking, check traffic, signal, enter slowly and center the vehicle before stopping and securing it.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: When backing out of an angled or perpendicular space, continue checking mirrors and direct views until the front bumper clears the neighboring vehicle before turning the rear toward the intended direction.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After clearing the parking space, stop, select forward drive and accelerate smoothly while straightening the steering.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: To parallel park, select a suitable space, check traffic, signal and look behind while backing slowly into it.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: During parallel parking, turn to bring the vehicle into the space, stop short of the rear vehicle and use forward drive to adjust its position.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Before leaving a parallel space, check all directions with mirrors and direct head checks and back sufficiently to create room ahead.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Signal before moving forward out of a parallel space and ensure the front bumper clears the vehicle ahead, correcting position if necessary.
